Evan / Marissa — preliminary findings from infra: we99re seeing an "aggregation-window overlap" condition inside our metering pipeline that created duplicated metering events for a subset of routed requests during a transient failover.

What happened (short):
- At 09:01 PST on Aug 24, a short routing flap caused requests for the same 60s aggregation bucket to be processed by two aggregator instances.
- Our dedupe key relied on a per-instance nonce plus timestamp; because the transient reroute changed the perceived shard owner mid-window, both aggregators emitted meter events that were not collapsed downstream.
- Result: a small fraction of micro-batches (~0.6% of requests during the burst window) produced two metering records and therefore two chargeable line items.

We99ve opened INF-1243 (link below) and attached a CSV sample of the raw usage rows from the pipeline that show duplicate ids and timestamps: usage-sample-aug24.csv (attached). We99re prioritizing a fix to the dedupe key to include a stable request id and to harden the aggregator leader election so windows are never duplicated during failover.

Immediate remediation we99re doing:
- Marking the duplicated meter events as void in billing exports for impacted accounts (automated filter).
- Building a corrective invoice for any customers where the duplicates produced a net charge.

We99ll provide an estimated customer-level impact within 48 hours and a proposed credit/adjustment.

Karthik

Evan — following up with the final customer-facing summary and next steps. Attached is the postmortem PDF with timelines, impact metrics, and the permanent remediation we99re shipping (postmortem-aug29.pdf). Key notes:

- Root cause: aggregator leader-election + nonce design allowed overlapping windows during a routing flap, creating duplicate meter events.
- Impact: Stellar Data experienced an overcharge equal to one duplicated aggregation bucket during the Aug 24 burst (estimated charge $1,280).
- Action taken: immediate voiding of duplicated meter events, provisional credit issued today for $1,280, corrected invoice to be posted by Sep 5.
- Permanent fixes: stable request id in dedupe key, leader-election timeout increase, and an integration test added to prevent regressions.

Call notes and links:
- Postmortem: https://drive.redwood.com/file/d/1a2b3c/postmortem
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-1243
- HubSpot record: https://redwood.app/hubspot/contacts/CH-7921

If everything looks good on your side, no action is needed — credit will reflect on your next billing cycle and the corrected invoice will appear on Sep 5. If you prefer a walkthrough, Stephanie and I are on the call scheduled for Mon Aug 30 at 10am PT.

Thanks for your patience — we99ve also added Stellar Data to our early notification list for any future metering pipeline changes so you99re notified in advance.
